name: the-hidden-bar-gives-its-room-back
description: Cmd+Shift+D hides the sidebar's own address bar, and the rows below move up into its place instead of sitting under a blank strip. The hoisted row's room is a padding on the pane, so the page's computed padding is the reading, and a capture pair shows the rows moved.

actions.expression: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.railpane .sidebar'); return s ? getComputedStyle(s).paddingTop : 'no-railpane'; })()
actions.note: THE CONTROL: the row's room is reserved while the bar shows.

actions.expression: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.railpane .sidebar'); return s ? getComputedStyle(s).paddingTop : 'no-railpane'; })()
actions.note: The bar's 34px came back to the rows.

assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: the reserved room is there while the bar shows.
The room shrank by the bar's height.
In pixels: the band the bar and the first rows stood in changed, because the rows moved up into it.
